Administrators.UserName: The email address or username of the user, used for identification and login purposes.
Administrators.FirstName: The given first name of the user.
Administrators.LastName: The family or last name of the user.
Administrators.Email: The user's primary email address for communication and notifications.
Administrators.LocationGroup: The name of the organization or group the user belongs to.
Administrators.LocationGroupId: The unique numeric identifier for the user's location group.
Administrators.OrganizationGroupUuid: The universally unique identifier (UUID) for the user's organization group.
Administrators.TimeZone: The user's time zone, used for scheduling and time-related functions.
Administrators.Locale: The user's language and regional preference (e.g., en-US).
Administrators.InitialLandingPage: The default page the user lands on after logging in.
Administrators.LastLoginTimeStamp: The date and time when the user last logged into the system.

Roles.Id: The unique identifier of the role assigned to the administrator.
Roles.Uuid: The universally unique identifier (UUID) for the role.
Roles.Name: The name of the role, describing its permissions or job function.
Roles.LocationGroup: The location group associated with this role.
Roles.LocationGroupId: The unique numeric identifier for the location group associated with this role.
Roles.OrganizationGroupUuid: The UUID of the organization group linked to this role.
Roles.IsActive: Indicates whether this role is currently active.
Roles.UserLinkId: A system-generated link identifier for this role.

Administrators.IsActiveDirectoryUser: Indicates whether the user is an Active Directory user.
Administrators.RequiresPasswordChange: Indicates whether the user must change their password upon the next login.
Administrators.MessageTemplateId: The identifier for the message template associated with the user.
Administrators.Id_Value: A unique identifier for the user.
Administrators.Uuid: A universally unique identifier (UUID) assigned to the user.

Applications.ApplicationName: The name of the application being managed or installed.
Applications.BundleId: The unique identifier for the application bundle (e.g., com.example.app).
Applications.AppVersion: The version number of the application currently in use.
Applications.ActualFileVersion: The specific file version of the application binary.
Applications.AppType: The type of application (e.g., Internal, Public, Managed).
Applications.Status: The current operational status of the application (e.g., Active, Inactive).
Applications.Platform: The platform type the application is associated with (e.g., Android, iOS).

SupportedModels.ApplicationId: The unique identifier for the supported model of the application.
SupportedModels.ModelId: The unique identifier for the device model supported by the application.
SupportedModels.ModelName: The name of the device model supported by the application.

Applications.AssignmentStatus: The status of the application's assignment to devices or groups (e.g., Assigned, Unassigned).
Applications.ApplicationSize: The total size of the application file (e.g., 11.30 MB).

SmartGroups.Id: The unique identifier for the smart group associated with the application.
SmartGroups.Name: The name of the smart group associated with the application.

Applications.IsReimbursable: Indicates whether the application is eligible for reimbursement.
Applications.ApplicationSource: The source type of the application (e.g., 0 for internal, 1 for public).
Applications.LocationGroupId: The unique identifier of the location group associated with the application.
Applications.RootLocationGroupName: The name of the root location group where the application is managed.
Applications.OrganizationGroupUuid: The universally unique identifier (UUID) for the organization group managing the application.
Applications.LargeIconUri: The URI pointing to the large icon asset of the application.
Applications.MediumIconUri: The URI pointing to the medium icon asset of the application.
Applications.SmallIconUri: The URI pointing to the small icon asset of the application.
Applications.PushMode: The push mode used for deploying the application (e.g., 0 for manual, 1 for automatic).
Applications.AppRank: The rank or priority assigned to the application.
Applications.AssignedDeviceCount: The total number of devices the application is currently assigned to.
Applications.InstalledDeviceCount: The total number of devices the application is installed on.
Applications.NotInstalledDeviceCount: The total number of devices where the application is not installed.
Applications.AutoUpdateVersion: Indicates whether the application is set to auto-update to newer versions.
Applications.EnableProvisioning: Indicates whether provisioning is enabled for the application.
Applications.IsDependencyFile: Indicates whether the application file is a dependency file.
Applications.ContentGatewayId: The unique identifier for the content gateway associated with the application.
Applications.IconFileName: The filename of the icon asset for the application.
Applications.ApplicationFileName: The filename of the application file.
Applications.MetadataFileName: The filename of the metadata file associated with the application.
Applications.Id_Value: A unique identifier for the application entry.
Applications.Uuid: The universally unique identifier (UUID) for the application.

Devices.DeviceId: A unique identifier for the device managed by the system.
Devices.DeviceUuid: A universally unique identifier (UUID) assigned to the device.
Devices.Udid: The unique device identifier (UDID) assigned to the device.
Devices.SerialNumber: The serial number of the device, used for hardware identification.

Devices.OrganizationGroupUuid: The UUID of the organization group managing the device.

Devices.LastSeen: The last time the device was online and communicated with the system.
Devices.EnrollmentDate: The date when the device was enrolled into the management system.
Devices.Compliant: Indicates whether the device complies with all configured policies.
Devices.AssetNumber: An identifier assigned to the device for asset management purposes.
Devices.EnrollmentStatus: The current enrollment status of the device (e.g., Enrolled, Unenrolled).
Devices.UnEnrolledDate: The date and time when the device was last unenrolled from the system.

DeviceNetworkInfo.ConnectionType: The type of network connection the device is using (e.g., Wifi, Cellular).
DeviceNetworkInfo.IPAddress: The IP address of the device.
DeviceNetworkInfo.MACAddress: The MAC address of the device.

Products.ProductId: The unique identifier of the product installed or managed on the device.
Products.Name: The name of the product installed or managed on the device.
Products.Status: The compliance status of the product installed on the device.

SmartGroups.SmartGroupId: The unique identifier of the smart group associated with the device.

SmartGroups.Name: The name of the smart group associated with the device.

CustomAttributes.Name: The name of the custom attribute.
CustomAttributes.Value: The value of the custom attribute.
CustomAttributes.ApplicationGroup: The application group associated with the custom attribute.

OrganizationGroup.Name: The name of the organization group, representing its primary label or identifier.

OrganizationGroup.ParentLocationGroup_Uuid: The UUID of the parent location group that this group belongs to.

OrganizationGroup.LgLevel: The level of the location group within the organizational hierarchy.

OrganizationGroup.Devices: The number of devices associated with this organization group.
OrganizationGroup.Id_Value: A unique identifier for the organization group.
OrganizationGroup.Uuid: The universally unique identifier (UUID) for the organization group.

Products.ID_Value: The unique identifier for the product managed within the system.
Products.PlatformID: The identifier of the platform the product is associated with (e.g., 5 for Android).
Products.Name: The name of the product, describing its primary purpose or version.
Products.ManagedByOrganizationGroupID: The ID of the organization group responsible for managing this product.
Products.Description: A brief description of the product's purpose or functionality.
Products.ManagedByOrganizationGroupName: The name of the organization group managing this product.

SmartGroups.Name: The name of the smart group associated with the product.

Products.TotalAssigned: The total number of devices assigned to this product.

Products.ActivationOrDeactivationType: Specifies how the product is activated or deactivated (e.g., Manual).

Products.Version: The version number of the product.
Products.ProductETag: A unique ETag for tracking changes to the product.

Profiles.ProfileName: The name of the profile, used to identify its purpose or configuration.
